semantic.justification: Task76 general-copy progress ports original CopyCellsFromClipHandler and CopyTextAttrsFromClipHandler with real typed source blocks,two content/metadata passes,independent native cursor values,context writeback and foreign string re-interning. ScColumn scalar/hinted SetValue/SetRawString/SetFormulaCell overloads retain native defaults,return contracts,broadcast controls and actual group/listener owners. Table2 CopyFromClip validates/clamps the destination and dispatches actual source columns;CONTENTS preserves destination patterns and geometry. ParseBlock now represents its actual container-event template and borrowed node fields;bounded ProcessFormula dispatches real formula pointers and separate non-formula spans. Original column/table/document SetDirtyFromClip,rectangular individual/area BroadcastCells and deferred BroadcastAction use existing bulk owners and actual subscriptions;cached formula results are dirtied only in completion. Matrix,foreign-pool formulas,number-format inheritance,full formatter/notes/edit/drawing services,group-compute cache invalidation and shell/UNO stream notifications remain unrepresented. Native general document/reference orchestration,paste undo/redo and EnterBlock/UI acceptance remain pending;this is not full task76 acceptance or full parity. Task76 conditional-index binding ports document/table/column/ScAttrArray AddCondFormatData/AddCondFormat over the actual canonical attribute runs. Valid rows always have the real default pattern;run clipping,index union,unsigned keys,idempotent insertion,existing attributes and holder destruction are retained. Conditional copy orchestration,style migration,painting and full paste history remain unverified.
